title: Telemetry event (one line of telemetry/events.jsonl)
description: Append-only. Every event carries rd — the join key for traceability, per-RD costing, and the live board (plan §10).

rd.description: Join key for traceability/costing/board. Real string ids MUST match the pattern below. A large, legitimate class of events has no RD at all: project-level phase work (phases 0-6, 10 — ba/sa/planner/risk-gov/agentops never hold an rd/*.md claim lock, so there is nothing to resolve), and any tool call whose text carries no RD id while zero or >1 locks are held (genuinely ambiguous — see hooks/lib/common.sh's 'Identity fallback' section). JSON `null` (not the string "null") is the deliberate, schema-legal way to represent 'no RD context at emission time' — emitters must never coerce this into a fake pattern-matching placeholder just to satisfy this field.

agent.description: "unknown" is deliberate, not a bug: it is the honest value when a hook's best-effort identity resolution (env var -> per-RD lock -> sole active lock -> RD frontmatter's assigned_agent) genuinely cannot determine who is acting — e.g. no RD is claimed at all (phase-level work), or more than one RD is claimed and this tool call's text names none of them. See hooks/emit-telemetry.sh and hooks/lib/common.sh's 'Identity fallback' section.

event.description: test_red/test_green: cz-build.md's red/green proof beats (distinct from generic test_run — these are the only reliable signal that a build loop actually reached red or green for a given content_hash). gate_rejected: cz-gate.md's explicit rejection marker (distinct from a routine lock_restamped handoff, which reads identically to a normal role handoff — see cz-gate.md step 8). lock_restamped: restamp-lock.sh's mid-claim identity relabel (test-designer -> dev -> cz-build within one held lock; distinct from rd_claim/rd_release which start/end the claim itself). agent_heartbeat: emit-telemetry.sh's heartbeat-file write, but only logged to telemetry on a REAL transition (this agent moved onto a different RD, or this is its first heartbeat) — logging every tick would flood the log. changelog_gap/citation_stale/lineage_exhausted/decision_gap: the four non-blocking advisories added per /cz:health-check's 2026-08-10 AIBOOTCAMP run (hooks/warn-rd-changelog.sh, hooks/warn-freshness.sh, hooks/warn-decision-coverage.sh) — each records, at write time, exactly one gap health-check could previously only find retroactively by hand: changelog_gap (a version>=2 RD with no notes: field, rd carries the RD id, rd_version the version), citation_stale (a src/**/tests/** file still citing a just-withdrawn/superseded RD id, rd carries the dead RD id, result carries the citing file's relative path, rd_state the RD's new state), lineage_exhausted (a REQ whose entire RD lineage just went withdrawn/superseded with no live successor, rd is null since this is REQ-level not RD-level, result carries the REQ id), decision_gap (a RISK.md hazard:HIGH module with no #### ADR-NNN heading in its ARCH.md section and no deliverables/adr/*.md file, rd is null, result carries the module name). All four are advisory-only, like hazard_escalation — never a reason a gate or transition was denied.
